title: Scenario 2: Shorter Onboarding Checklist
question: Your team tested cutting onboarding from 5 steps to 3 steps. Should you ship the new variant now?
explanation: Correct answer: SHIP. The 95% credible interval (+9.1% to +27.7%) is strictly positive, the planned sample (840 >= 800) is reached, the 50/50 split is balanced, and the support-ticket guardrail did not regress.

memo.summary: Safe to roll out: credible interval is strictly positive, planned sample reached, and integrity/guardrail checks pass.
reasons: 95% credible interval (+9.1% to +27.7%) is entirely above zero.
Planned sample reached: 840 / 800 exposures (420 per arm).
No guardrail regression on Day-7 support ticket rate.
memo.next_action: Propose rollout of the 3-step variant (requires human approval).

checks.name: prob_vs_interval
checks.detail: Win probability 99% aligns with strictly positive interval.

checks.name: guardrail
checks.detail: Day-7 support ticket rate stable (-0.4%, CI [-1.8%, +1.0%]).
